verdict.rationale: WooCommerce's own webhooks let a user configure an event that automatically triggers an outbound notification to a chosen URL. That is a narrow form of event-triggered action, not a rule engine with conditions and in-product actions. Storefront add_action() hooks are developer building blocks for template insertion and earn no credit. Missing for 10: conditional rule definition, a choice of in-product actions beyond sending a notification, a no-code automation builder, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: You (or your developer) can configure a webhook that is triggered by events on one site
Webhooks let your WooCommerce store send automatic event notifications to a URL of your choice.
